# Reservoir_Computing_Branch_Prediction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that uses reservoir computing, a type of recurrent neural network with fixed random weights, to predict branch outcomes in pipelined processors. This bridges neuromorphic computing with traditional processor architecture, potentially enabling low-power, high-speed branch prediction using memristive hardware.
